description: Three eligible, plausible word-bank entries ('සල්ලි'->money, 'බස්'->bus, 'ආදරේ'->love, all human-verified/source=native or loanword). At heavy severity (k=2) exactly 2 distinct word TYPES must be substituted, not 1 and not 3 — proves heavy genuinely draws 2 when 2+ are available, distinct from the capped-at-1 behavior covered by codemix_lexicon_substitution.json. UPDATED round 4: this now also demonstrates the attestation-aware selection redesign (src/noisers/codemix.py's 4-level priority) — 'bus' and 'love' both have PRIMARY evidence (real SOLD sentences where a person actually switched to them, see data/lexicon/codemix_attested_vocabulary.json), while 'money' has only TERTIARY evidence (count=2, excluded from the selection gate — see the module docstring's 'crazy' finding for why). So the plausible+attested pool is exactly {'බස්','ආදරේ'} (size 2 == k), and the draw becomes FORCED rather than a 2-of-3 random pick: 'සල්ලි' is never chosen at this seed or any other, because it never enters the top-priority pool at all. Pre-round-4 expected_text was 'money bus ආදරේ' (a uniform draw over all 3); re-derived here by re-running the noiser at the frozen seed per LOG.md convention.
